note: FNS 752 is a QC review procedure, not a caseworker policy requirement. It instructs QC reviewers on how to document and disposition cases where a household is receiving benefits beyond an expired certification period — specifically what the reviewer must investigate (whether the state sent recertification documents, household compliance, how benefits continued). These are audit instructions for QC staff, not policy rules that caseworkers implement. The underlying policy elements that 752 references — the state's obligation to mail recertification forms 45 days before the end of the certification period, BEACON's automatic case closing when recertification is incomplete, the NOMI process, and reinstatement procedures for untimely/incomplete recertifications — are all well-covered in the OLG across both Change Reporting and Simplified Reporting recertification pages. BEACON automatically closes cases when recertification is not completed by the release date, which is the system mechanism that prevents the scenario 752 describes (benefits continuing past an expired cert period). The three exceptions 752 lists (missing application from record, missing signature, missing interview documentation) are QC disposition rules about when NOT to find a case ineligible during review — these have no caseworker equivalent.
